name: blenderlens-mcp

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Report the attached Blender without starting one. Returns: the session (busy: what it runs), add-on, Blender, render_dir, recovery copies. WHEN TO CALL: first; after not_connected, connection_lost, busy.

tools.name: open_session
tools.description: Attach to the live Blender window or start a background one. Returns: the session. WHEN TO CALL: to pick a mode or file; else the first call attaches by BLENDERLENS_MODE.

mode.description: auto (default): live if the add-on replies

discard.description: Allow losing unsaved or busy work

tools.name: close_session
tools.description: Disconnect: a background Blender exits, a live one stays open. Returns: the mode closed. WHEN TO CALL: when the work is saved.

discard.description: Allow losing unsaved or busy work

tools.name: get_scene
tools.description: Read the scene. Returns: file state, units, and each object's type, parent, location, dimensions, counts, materials, modifiers. WHEN TO CALL: before building; after not_found.

tools.name: get_object
tools.description: Read one object in full. Returns: transform, bounds, properties, counts before and after modifiers, modifier settings by Blender's names, slots. WHEN TO CALL: before set_modifier.

tools.name: get_mesh
tools.description: List a mesh's faces. Returns: each face's index, center, normal, side, area, material slot. WHEN TO CALL: for face indices; again after faces change.

material.description: Its faces only: slot or name

tools.name: list_materials
tools.description: List materials. Returns: each one's values (linear, as glTF) and users. WHEN TO CALL: before set_material, to reuse one.

tools.name: check_asset
tools.description: Check meshes as exported: topology, normals, scale, origin, UVs, textures, morphs, overlaps; and a project's rules or rules_file (the guide lists the keys). Returns: passed; per object stats, issues {code, severity, count, faces}. WHEN TO CALL: before export_glb.

tools.name: measure_objects
tools.description: Measure between objects' surfaces as exported, in world space, or cast a ray. Returns: per pair distance, closest points, touching, overlapping, overlap_faces, inside; ray object, location, normal, face. WHEN TO CALL: to fit parts, find gaps.

objects.description: 2 to 16; a ray may hit only these

tools.name: create_object
tools.description: Add a primitive (tube, lathe and text too) or an empty, sized in the mesh so scale stays 1. Returns: its name (.001 on a clash), transform, counts. WHEN TO CALL: to start a part.

size.description: cube edges (2); plane, grid [x, y]; monkey, empty, text: a number

tools.name: create_mesh
tools.description: Build a mesh object from vertices and faces in its own space. Returns: as create_object. WHEN TO CALL: for a shape no primitive gives.

tools.name: edit_mesh
tools.description: Run one operation on the faces picked (faces, facing) or all. bevel: the picked faces' rim edges (all edges if all faces), or with angle the edges sharper than it. amount, offset, pivot: mesh space. Returns: result_faces (extrude: the cap; inset: inner faces), counts. WHEN TO CALL: to shape a primitive.

amount.description: extrude distance, inset border, bevel width, merge distance, solidify thickness (inward)

direction.description: extrude this way; bisect plane normal (world)

pivot.description: scale, rotate about; bisect plane point (default center)

angle.description: Degrees: sharper edges stay sharp (shade_smooth), bevel, seam (30); dissolve_planar (5)

tools.name: add_modifier
tools.description: Add a modifier to an object's stack. Returns: its settings, the stack, counts. WHEN TO CALL: for detail that stays editable.

type.description: bevel, array, boolean, subdivision, mirror, solidify...

settings.description: Blender's names (width, count, levels, operation...); objects by name

tools.name: set_modifier
tools.description: Change a modifier's settings, place or visibility. Returns: as add_modifier. WHEN TO CALL: to tune one.

tools.name: apply_modifier
tools.description: Bake a modifier into the mesh; refused for a shared mesh or in edit mode. Returns: the stack, counts. WHEN TO CALL: when edit_mesh must see its result.

tools.name: remove_modifier
tools.description: Remove a modifier unapplied. Returns: the stack left, counts. WHEN TO CALL: to undo add_modifier.

tools.name: set_material
tools.description: Create or update a material, optionally on an object or its picked faces; all its users change; '' clears an image or vertex_color. Returns: its values, slot, faces. WHEN TO CALL: after shaping.

base_color.description: [r, g, b(, a)] linear, or '#RRGGBB' sRGB

alpha_mode.description: With an image or vertex_color, their alpha

tools.name: set_vertex_color
tools.description: Paint the faces picked (faces, facing) or all into a color attribute. Returns: faces painted, materials wired, and not_wired (setups not BlenderLens's). WHEN TO CALL: for colour without textures; exports as COLOR_0.

tools.name: unwrap_uv
tools.description: Unwrap a mesh into a UV map; projections are packed. Returns: islands, area used, overlapping and out-of-bounds faces, texel density (px/m at 1024). WHEN TO CALL: before texturing or baking; unwrap needs seams (edit_mesh mark_seams).

tools.name: join_objects
tools.description: Join meshes into the first, keeping each piece's materials and faces. Returns: the object, slots and their faces. WHEN TO CALL: to make one part of pieces.

tools.name: set_transform
tools.description: Set an object's location, rotation, scale or dimensions; null keeps a component. Returns: the transform; after drop, landed_on and moved_by. WHEN TO CALL: to place parts.

drop.description: Then move along Z to rest on what is below, or on this object

tools.name: apply_transform
tools.description: Bake rotation and scale into the mesh, or move its origin, mesh and children staying put; refused for a shared mesh or in edit mode. Returns: the transform. WHEN TO CALL: after scaling, before bevel or solidify.

origin.description: New origin, or a world point

tools.name: set_parent
tools.description: Parent an object, or clear its parent. Returns: the transform. WHEN TO CALL: to assemble parts into one node tree.

tools.name: set_collection
tools.description: Move objects into a collection. Returns: their collections. WHEN TO CALL: to group parts.

tools.name: set_object
tools.description: Rename or hide an object, or set its display or custom properties (exported as glTF extras). Returns: its state. WHEN TO CALL: to name, hide or tag parts.

empty_display.description: An empty's shape: ARROWS, CUBE, SPHERE...

properties.description: JSON values, 8 levels deep; null removes

tools.name: duplicate_object
tools.description: Copy an object with modifiers, materials and children. Returns: the copies. WHEN TO CALL: for repeated parts.

tools.name: delete_object
tools.description: Delete objects and unused mesh data. Returns: the names deleted. WHEN TO CALL: to remove parts.

tools.name: export_glb
tools.description: Write a .glb, Y-up (-Y front becomes +Z), for a target engine; what it cannot load is refused, as is edit mode. Returns: the file read back, with warnings for the target. WHEN TO CALL: to deliver.

vertex_colors.description: Default material: those a material reads

tools.name: import_file
tools.description: Import a .glb, .gltf, .obj, .fbx, .stl or .ply, or append from a .blend what is named. Returns: what it added. WHEN TO CALL: for a reference, or to check an export.

tools.name: save_file
tools.description: Save the open file. Returns: path, size. WHEN TO CALL: at milestones; before closing a background session.

copy.description: A checkpoint; the open file keeps its path

tools.name: open_file
tools.description: Open a .blend in place of the open file. Returns: the scene. WHEN TO CALL: to resume work.

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Start a new, unsaved file in place of the open one. Returns: the scene. WHEN TO CALL: for a new model.

empty.description: Default true; else Blender's default scene

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: Render a PNG of objects (and children) or all visible geometry, framed, others hidden, the scene unchanged. Returns: its path (open it, or inline). WHEN TO CALL: after each build step.

engine.description: Default auto: cycles (CPU); eevee needs GPU

tools.name: animate_object
tools.description: Key an object's transform and shape keys into a named clip on an NLA track, exported as one glTF animation; a call replaces the object's keys in it. Returns: channels, frames, seconds, Godot warnings. WHEN TO CALL: for doors, rotors, morphs.

keys.description: {frame, location, rotation (degrees), scale, shape_key: {name: value}}; null skips an axis

loop.description: Repeat; default as Godot reads the name

tools.name: create_collision
tools.description: Add a collision proxy over a mesh, wire-drawn and parented; named for Godot, three.js exports leave it out. Returns: its name, counts, closed, volume_ratio. WHEN TO CALL: for physics props.

tools.name: bake_texture
tools.description: Bake a mesh's materials into a PNG through a UV map with Cycles (CPU), wired into them; render settings and selection are put back. Returns: path, size, seconds, image_driven channels. WHEN TO CALL: for procedural materials, AO.

type.description: Default diffuse; ao multiplies base colour

tools.name: export_file
tools.description: Write FBX, OBJ, STL, PLY or USD (by extension), objects chosen as export_glb does; the file is read back in a scratch scene. Returns: path, bytes, read_back counts. WHEN TO CALL: for tools that take no glTF.

tools.name: run_python
tools.description: Run Python in Blender (bpy, bmesh, mathutils); names persist; set result to return it. Returns: stdout, stderr, result. WHEN TO CALL: only for what no tool covers.

tools.name: run_script
tools.description: Run a .py file in Blender as run_python does, with args; its folder, and parents up to a blenderlens.toml, are importable afresh each run. Returns: result, stdout, stderr, objects added, removed, changed. WHEN TO CALL: to build a model from its script.

tools.name: undo_change
tools.description: Step back through undo steps, one per call that changed something; Python references go stale. Returns: steps undone, counts, unsaved_changes. WHEN TO CALL: to take back calls that went wrong.

instructions:
BlenderLens gives you a Blender session to model in. In live mode it is the Blender window the user watches, with the BlenderLens add-on running. In background mode it is a Blender the server starts itself when no such window is open.
- You work on the open .blend file's objects, their meshes, modifiers, materials, transforms and collections, and on .glb exports and preview renders.
- Every call goes to the attached session. `get_status` says which session that is, without starting one. The first call that needs Blender attaches by BLENDERLENS_MODE. In auto mode that is the Blender window running the add-on when it responds, and otherwise a background Blender. `open_session` and `close_session` choose explicitly. A background session's unsaved work is lost when it ends, so call `save_file` to keep it.
- Build with `create_object`, `create_mesh`, `edit_mesh`, `add_modifier` and `set_material`. Look with `render_preview`, whose PNG you open (or get inline), and `get_object`. Check with `check_asset` and `measure_objects`. Deliver with `export_glb`, which reads the written file back and reports what it holds. `undo_change` takes calls back.
- Units are metres and rotations are degrees. Z is up, and a model's front faces -Y. export_glb converts to glTF's Y-up, where that front faces +Z. Colours are linear unless given as '#RRGGBB'.
- No tool paints textures, sculpts or rigs. `run_python` and `run_script`, when enabled, reach those and anything else, but use the tools first.
- Read the resource blenderlens://guide for the conventions, the traps and the build, look, check, export loop.
- A refusal is a structured error with `error`, `exit`, `kind` and `hint`. Kind `not_found` says what is missing. `bad_argument` names what is accepted. `not_connected` means no add-on responded. `connection_lost` means Blender went away. `unsaved_changes` asks for save_file or discard. `deadline` means this call ran out of time while Blender kept working on it. `busy` means Blender was still working on an earlier call, so this one was not sent. `not_allowed` means this server or that Blender forbids it. `blender_missing` means no executable was found.
